comparison.objective: Snap a specimen swab at its breakpoint while its tip remains in a free-standing transport tube, then discard the handle.
comparison.physical_skill: Brace a light tube while applying controlled bending force to break a slender shaft at a designated point.
comparison.success_condition: Correct in-tube break, handle in waste cup, tube upright with tip retained, all objects still, and grippers clear; spill or tip removal scores zero.
comparison.reason: Controlled breakage while stabilizing a container does not test aperture-based separation or retention of mixed loose rigid bodies. No material rubric details are missing.
